title: The map, packed
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Wednesday. Chloe packs the map he drew her in 1999 — the city he's never seen. She packs it in the front pocket. He sees. The strip draws the pocket.

panels.composition: Chloe's room, boxes. CHLOE folding a sheet of paper: a hand-drawn map, streets, a needle tower. WOOD in the doorway.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young woman in a half-packed room folding a hand-drawn map with a needle-shaped tower on it, a young man in the doorway

panels.composition: The map going into the front pocket of the bag. Not the suitcase. The pocket you reach into on a bus.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, close-up of a folded paper going into the front zip pocket of a duffel bag

panels.composition: Wood, seeing where it went. Saying nothing about it.

balloons.text: It's wrong. The map. I made up half of it.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young man in a doorway watching a young woman zip a bag pocket, speaking

panels.composition: The bag zipped. The pocket. Chloe's hand flat on it, once. Wood looking at the hand.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a young woman's hand resting flat on a duffel bag's front pocket while a young man watches, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: The map in the pocket you reach into on a bus. 'I'll find out which half.'
